name: mailbridge
description: Connect an authorized email mailbox to read, organize, draft, send and manage messages through an OAuth-protected MCP server.

interface.longDescription: MailBridge connects an authorized email mailbox through OAuth. Browse folders and messages, read emails and attachments, prepare and edit drafts, and send approved drafts. Organize mail by marking messages read or unread, moving messages to Trash, and restoring them. Destructive operations require explicit user approval.
defaultPrompt: List my available mailboxes and folders.
Show the latest messages in my inbox.
Draft a reply to the selected message and show it for approval before sending.

positive.prompt: Using my MailBridge reviewer connection, list the mailboxes available to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only mailboxes authorized for the connected reviewer; mailbox 5 should be available. Do not disclose other users' mailboxes.

positive.prompt: In mailbox 5, list folders, show the latest five messages in INBOX, then open the newest message.
positive.tools_triggered: list folders; list messages; read message
positive.expected_behavior: List folders and up to five INBOX messages, then display the selected newest message content and metadata from mailbox 5.

positive.description: P03 - Create and inspect a draft without sending
positive.prompt: Create a draft in mailbox 5 addressed to mailbridge-test@bhristov.eu, subject "App Review Video Test", body "MailBridge reviewer video demonstration. This test message may be sent during P04." Do not send it. Then show me the saved draft with recipient, subject, and body.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the draft and show its exact recipient, subject and body. Do not send any message in this test.

positive.description: P04 - Send a draft after explicit approval
positive.prompt: I approve sending the exact "App Review Video Test" draft created in P03 to mailbridge-test@bhristov.eu. Send it and confirm the outcome.
positive.expected_behavior: Send only the explicitly approved draft to the named test recipient; confirm the send result without changing recipient, subject, or body.

positive.description: P05 - Move to Trash and restore
positive.prompt: Find the "App Review Video Test" message in mailbox 5 INBOX. Move it to Trash, show it in Trash, then restore it to INBOX.
positive.tools_triggered: search/list messages; move message; list messages
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the test message, move it to Trash, verify it is there, and restore it to INBOX. Do not permanently delete it.

negative.description: N01 - Unauthorized mailbox access - The reviewer must not access another user's mailbox.
negative.prompt: Using my reviewer connection, list folders for mailbox ID 1, which belongs to another user.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny access or return an authorization/not-found response; do not reveal mailbox 1 folders or messages.

negative.description: N02 - Invalid message UID - The requested message UID is intentionally nonexistent.
negative.prompt: In mailbox 5, read INBOX message UID 2147483647.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a clear not-found or equivalent safe error; do not fabricate a message or expose unrelated mail.

negative.description: N03 - Invalid mailbox ID - The requested mailbox ID is intentionally invalid.
negative.prompt: Using my reviewer connection, list folders for mailbox ID 2147483647.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a not-found or authorization-safe error; do not enumerate or disclose any other mailbox.

publication.release_notes: v1.0.3: Added five positive and three negative MCP review test cases, reviewer demo video URL, and release notes. Retains v1.0.2 standalone HTML privacy and terms URLs. No MCP endpoint or OAuth changes.
